name: The Processional Way
_comment: The open area. Geometry here mirrors the Blender scene the panoramas were
rendered from - build_demo.py places wall panels 28.6m long and 7.6m tall
at x = +/-15, stepping down the avenue every 35.6m - so the collision and
the backdrop agree with each other.
The panorama is used as a distant backdrop only. It has no parallax, so
anything close enough to walk past has to exist as real geometry or the
illusion breaks the moment you move.

backdrop._comment: Rendered from this point; the further the player walks from it, the more the backdrop lies. Bounds are kept tight enough that it stays unnoticed.

move._comment: Metres per second, matched to the clips in remy.glb: the walk covers 1.19 m/s and the run 3.61, so both play near 1x and the feet do not skate. Backwards and sideways are scaled down in Walker.update to suit their own clips.

portals.label: Arcadia
portals._comment: The gate mouth. Walking here offers entry; the sensor requirement flips on later without touching this code.
